title: Research Agent
description: Citation-first research agent. Searches the web, reads sources, and answers with every claim anchored to a URL. Hardened: fetched pages are treated as attacker-controlled data (prompt-injection defense), never as instructions.

mcp.note: Published @agentskit/mcp@0.4.2 exposes the Registry research agent over stdio with bounded fetch_url and web_search tools; host-specific approval UX remains to be verified.
